title: The Cat's Little Gifts
text:
Every morning, {{name}} found a little gift by the door. One day it was a leaf. Next day it was a small stone. Then a yellow flower came too. {{name}} was very curious. "Who brings these gifts to me?" {{name}} said.

One morning, {{name}} woke up early. A gray cat was at the door! The cat put down a tiny stone. Then the cat ran away fast. {{name}} wanted to know more. "I am going to follow the cat," said {{name}}.

{{name}} walked slowly behind the cat. The cat went past the garden. It went under a big tree. There was an old box on the ground. {{name}} looked inside the box. Three tiny kittens were sleeping there!

The cat looked up at {{name}}. The kittens were hungry and cold. "I should help them," {{name}} said. {{name}} ran home and got some milk. {{name}} also brought a soft coat for the box.

The kittens drank the milk happily. The mother cat was very glad. When {{name}} sat down, one kitten climbed onto a knee. {{name}} smiled and felt warm inside.

Now {{name}} visits the box every day. The cat brings no more gifts. But {{name}} has a better gift now. Four new animal friends wait by the tree. They are the best friends in town.

questions.prompt: What did {{name}} find by the door each morning?
What was inside the old box?
How did {{name}} feel at the end?

summary: 主角发现每天门口都有小礼物,出于好奇跟踪一只灰猫,发现树下旧箱子里有三只又冷又饿的小猫;主角拿来牛奶和软外套帮助它们,从此和猫妈妈与小猫成了好朋友。
